name: Synn
message: 「No, I was just about to make some」

name: Sally
message: 「You don't need to make any. Heave-ho」

name: Sally
message: 「Here you go. A little treat from the Boss」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoaaa~~!! Is this thanks for KiraFes or something?」

name: Sally
message: 「Nope, not quite. You see, during KiraFes, we got scouted by a beef bowl shop」

name: Sally
message: 「So we started working part-time there today. Just for today, they gave us extra~」

name: Sally
message: 「You're always treating us to meals, Prez. So this is to say thanks」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Kindness is never wasted,' as they say--this right here is what that means.」
Since I hadn't expected anything in return, the joy hits even harder.

name: Sally
message: 「Food tastes so much better when we all eat together~♪」
Until Paqy showed up, I had been eating simple meals all by myself.
Now we've become a big household, and it's super lively.
Part of it is because we're eating beef bowls, sure, but having a noisy good time like this makes for a wonderful seasoning too.

name: Sally
message: 「From now on, since we're all living under the same roof, let's get along!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah! Let's join hands, help each other out, and do our best!」

name: Sally
message: 「Though it's not like I can always bring back beef bowls, okay?」
The world wasn't quite that sweet.
